newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU grants free-mkt wheat, barley, intervention rye.
newsitem.headline: EU grants free-mkt wheat, barley, intervention rye.

text.p: The European Union on Thursday awarded licences to export 311,300 tonnes of free-market soft wheat at a maximum refund of 16.59 Ecus per tonne, member country officials said.

It also granted licences to export 268,000 tonnes of free-market barley at a maximum refund of 31.49 Ecus per tonne and for 17,000 tonnes of rye at the same 31.49-Ecu refund, which was also unchanged from last week's refund for barley and rye.
It awarded 1,500 tonnes of oats at 32.80 Ecus.

In the intervention grain export tender, the EU sold 26,597 tonnes of German intervention rye at a minimum price of 94.38 Ecus per tonne for exports to countries outside the EU, member country officials said.
It granted licences for 17,000 tonnes of rye at the same 31.49-Ecu refund, which was also unchanged from last week's refund for barley and rye.
It also awarded 1,500 tonnes of oats at 32.80 Ecus.
French officials said afterwards that the exact figure for the maximum wheat export refund was 16.59 Ecus a tonne.
